metadata.subject: Planetary Aspects (Graha Drishti)
metadata.description: Complete planetary aspect rules including universal aspects, special aspects, aspect orbs, and graha drishti percentages

universal_aspects.description: All planets aspect the 7th house with full strength

7th_house.note: All 9 planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) aspect the 7th house with full drishti

special_aspects.description: Special aspects for specific planets beyond the universal 7th house aspect

7th_house.description: Mars aspects 7th house with full strength (universal aspect)

7th_house.description: Rahu aspects 7th house with full strength (universal aspect)

aspect_orbs.description: Orb ranges for traditional Western-style aspects (for reference in Vedic context)

graha_drishti_percentage.description: House-wise drishti (aspect) strength percentages for all planets

full_aspect.description: Full aspect on 7th house - All planets

quarter_aspect.description: 1/4 aspect - Jupiter, Rahu, Ketu on 5th & 9th houses

house_aspect_matrix.description: Complete matrix showing which planets aspect which houses

7th.note: Partnership, marriage, contracts - Universal aspect house

conjunction_based_aspects.description: In Vedic astrology, aspects are primarily based on house positions rather than degrees
conjunction_based_aspects.rule: A planet aspects the 7th house from its position, plus any special aspects based on its nature
conjunction_based_aspects.example: Mars in 1st house aspects the 4th (3/4), 7th (full), and 8th (3/4) houses

conjunction_conjunction.description: When planets occupy the same house (conjunction)
conjunction_conjunction.effect: Both planets aspect each other with full strength regardless of degree separation within the house

multiple_planets_same_house.description: When multiple planets aspect the same house
multiple_planets_same_house.effect: Each planet's aspect contributes separately; the combined effect is evaluated based on planet natures and their mutual relationships

aspect_strength_calculation.formula: Aspect Strength = Base Strength × Benefic/Malefic Factor × Dignity Factor

vedic_principles.drishti_definition: Drishti means 'sight' or 'vision' - the aspect or influence a planet casts upon houses and other planets
vedic_principles.house_based: Unlike Western astrology which uses degree-based aspects, Vedic astrology uses house-based aspects
vedic_principles.strength_hierarchy: Full (7th) > 3/4 (3rd, 10th for Mars/Saturn) > 1/2 (4th, 8th for Mars) > 1/4 (5th, 9th for Jupiter/Rahu/Ketu)
vedic_principles.interpretation: Aspect strength indicates how much influence a planet exerts on the aspected house and its significations
